subject: Recap from discovery — are we aligned on next steps?
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Tseng <sam@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Ellie Park <ellie.park@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Jun 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap from discovery — are we aligned on next steps?

Hi Sam / Ellie,

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Acme's search-and-ranking use case. Quick recap from my side and a proposed next step so we can make progress without taking too much of your team's time: 

Summary of what we captured on the call:
- Primary goal: reduce query-latency for rerank pipeline from ~220ms to under 120ms for high-volume queries.
- Current infra: hybrid on-prem + cloud with bursts to GCP for training.
- Data sensitivity: PII in logs, SOC2 required — you flagged retention policy questions.
- Success metric: 5–10% improvement in relevance with <2x cost delta.

Proposed next step:
1) 2-week micro-pilot (limited to 2K daily queries) to validate latency/cost tradeoffs.
2) Redwood provides a lightweight test harness and sample config; Acme runs against a non-production sample.
3) Weekly sync (15 min) to review results and tune batching/quantization.

Questions for you: is the pilot scope above something that maps to your expectation? If yes, can you confirm an internal sponsor for procurement (approx timeline) and any required security pre-reqs (SOC2 evidence or additional forms)?

I attached my call notes (discovery-notes.pdf) and a one-pager that outlines the pilot steps and expected deliverables. If this looks good I can send a one-page mutual action plan and propose two calendar slots next Tuesday/Wednesday for a short kickoff.

Appreciate your feedback — even a quick line on whether this is still a priority for Q3 is helpful.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (PDF, 46 KB)

Subject: Quick follow-up — two quick questions

Hi Sam —

Just following up on my note below. Two very quick questions: 1) Is the pilot scope reasonable? 2) Is there a preferred week in July for a 15-min kickoff?

If you're swamped I can loop in Aditya (cc'ed on the thread) to handle contract/pricing details once we lock scope.

Thanks,
Neha

Subject: Final quick check — pause or keep this on radar?

Hi Sam —

Wanted to send one last quick, respectful nudge before I close the thread on my side. We haven't heard back since the pilot proposal and I wanted to confirm whether this effort is still on your roadmap for the coming quarter. A couple options if helpful: 

- We pause for now and I'll re-open when timing is better.
- We do a short, no-commitment technical review with a single engineer from your team (15–30 min) to validate feasibility.
- If procurement is the blocker, I can have Aditya run through a typical timeline and a pricing window so you have numbers to share internally.

If none of the above, a one-line reply ("not now") is totally fine — I just want to avoid leaving open items on our side.

Thanks for the consideration, and hope all is well on your end.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
